mānadinna.p: [Māna+dinna] (ti) CL=7 A person named Mānadinna.
pn: Mānadinna. A householder of Rājagaha. When he lay ill he was visited by Ānanda, to whom he confessed that even in his illness he practiced the four satipaṭṭhāna. He was quite free from the five orambhāgiyasaṁyojanā. SN.v.178.
a: မာနဒိန္န(တိ)
မာနဒိန္နမည်သော၊ သူ။

V: Mānadinna：A householder of Rājagaha．When he lay ill he was visited by Ananda，to whom he confessed that even in his illness he practiced the four satipatthāna．He was quite free from the five orambhāgiyasamyojanā． S．v．178．
